claims.claim: The call ran roughly 7 minutes.
claims.why: Transcript runs from 00:03 to 06:47, and the CRM end time is 09:07 against a 09:00 start.

claims.claim: Corvid uses its own OIDC provider and sends roles in a nested net_groups claim, an object with region and role.
claims.why: Ana asked and Fatima confirmed the nested claim with region and role.

claims.claim: Apex claim mapping supports only flat claims, a string or a list of strings.
claims.why: Ana stated this directly and release card RC-09 agrees.

claims.claim: Nested claims are not supported in general availability today.
claims.why: Ana said 'Not today in general availability.'

claims.claim: Ana said nested support is coming next quarter, but only from hearsay and with no confirmed date.
claims.why: She said next quarter, then said it was only what she heard from the product team.

claims.claim: Last night's run on Corvid's sample data (~1.2B rows/day, incremental) took 22 minutes versus about 5 hours for the current job.
claims.why: Both figures match the transcript.

claims.claim: Colin was happy with the pipeline result.
claims.why: His only positive remark, 'Even better,' was about the connector, and he said nothing about the 22-minute run.

claims.claim: Ana first said the connector syncs hourly, then corrected to continuous, about 1 minute end to end.
claims.why: Ana said hourly, then corrected herself, and RC-12 confirms continuous sync.

claims.claim: The architecture board needs a written SSO design and the nested-claims date, and meets monthly, next on November 3.
claims.why: Fatima stated this directly.

claims.claim: The transcript has timestamp jumps (00:32 to 02:40, 03:23 to 05:50), so content may be missing.
claims.why: The gaps exist in the transcript, and the output marks possible missing content as uncertain.

claims.claim: Fatima asked whether next quarter was committed and did not get a firm yes.
claims.why: She asked directly, and Ana answered with hearsay and a promise to get the date.

claims.claim: Fatima needs the nested-claims timing in writing for the architecture board.
claims.why: She said she needs it in writing for the board.

claims.claim: Colin said hourly sync was fine for BI.
claims.why: Direct quote.

claims.claim: Colin had a hard stop, so the pipeline discussion was brief.
claims.why: He said he had a hard stop and asked to move to the pipeline.

claims.claim: If 'next quarter' means calendar Q1 2027, nested support may land after the Dec 18 target close.
claims.why: The CRM close date is 2026-12-18 and the quarter was not defined; the output states it as conditional.

claims.claim: Derek said 'I'm sure' Corvid could join the preview program, but no one confirmed availability or eligibility.
claims.why: Derek's hedged offer is in the transcript, and nothing confirms eligibility.

claims.claim: The Nov 3 board is the only checkpoint before the Dec 18 close, and the next board is likely early December.
claims.why: Only monthly meetings and a Nov 3 date were stated; 'only checkpoint' and the December date are inferred.

claims.claim: CRM economic buyer is blank.
claims.why: The CRM economic_buyer field is empty.

claims.claim: CRM business outcome is blank and no stakeholder is recorded for the architecture board.
claims.why: The CRM business_outcome value and stakeholder_to_add are both empty.

claims.claim: Corvid's go-live date was not captured.
claims.why: No go-live date appears in the transcript or the CRM.

claims.claim: The 22-minute run was on Corvid's sample data in an Apex environment and has not been seen at production scale.
claims.why: The run used data Corvid sent; the Apex environment and the lack of production-scale testing are reasonable inferences, and the output flags them as unqualified.

claims.claim: Ana committed to send the written SSO design by Friday, October 9.
claims.why: Ana stated this directly.

claims.claim: Derek committed to send the nested-claims date along with the SSO design.
claims.why: Derek said he would send it along with the design.

claims.claim: Ana committed to get the exact nested-claims date from product, due before Oct 9 (implied).
claims.why: She said 'I'll get you the exact date'; the pre-Oct 9 timing is implied and marked as such.

claims.claim: Fatima committed to take the design and date to the architecture board at the Nov 3 meeting.
claims.why: She said the board needs the material and meets Nov 3, but never committed to submit it.

claims.claim: Preview program access was mentioned only by Derek and has no owner or date.
claims.why: Only Derek mentioned it, with no owner or date.

claims.claim: The CRM sc_commitment puts both the SSO design and nested claims date under the SC, while Derek owns the date in the call.
claims.why: The CRM text and the transcript ownership match this description.

claims.claim: The email says Apex is also checking with product on preview program access and will include what it learns.
claims.why: Nobody committed to check on or report back about preview access; Derek only said 'I'm sure'.

claims.claim: The email offers to walk through the SSO design with Fatima before she submits it.
claims.why: No walkthrough was offered or discussed in the call.

claims.claim: The warehouse connector now syncs continuously, about 1 minute end to end; hourly was the previous behavior.
claims.why: Ana's correction states this and release card RC-12 confirms it.
